scope: Connect the existing LIGHT callback and AC1021+ DXF serializer through dx_iface, complete bounded LIGHT DXF parsing, and preserve delivery through modelspace and named BLOCK callbacks.

references.title: Autodesk LIGHT (DXF), AutoCAD 2020
references.use: Defines the documented AcDbLight core fields and enum meanings used by the typed parser/readback controls. It does not document the adapter's color group 63, truecolor, or DWG photometric fields.

behavior: The DXF reader dispatches LIGHT and parses its bounded class/name/type/status, color index, position/target, intensity, attenuation, and shadow fields.
The ENTITIES delivery sink and BLOCK event sink forward LIGHT; block membership maps the callback to the LIGHT wire record.

The concrete writer requires the exact DRW_Light runtime type and refuses unrepresented truecolor/CMC and photometric/web/extended-light data, unsupported enum values, non-finite numeric fields, or colors outside the bounded ACI profile.
The reader refuses group 421 rather than discarding a LIGHT color value whose mapping is not qualified.

validationProfile.source: Locally constructed DRW_Light models. Tests write temporary output files only; no DWG/DXF fixtures are used or committed.
assertions: The AC1018 target is refused before the LIGHT AC1021 floor and an existing destination remains byte-identical.
Unqualified truecolor and non-default photometric data are refused atomically; the same adapter retries successfully after correction.
Modelspace and named-BLOCK output re-imports as one typed LIGHT with representative AcDbLight fields preserved.
The named-BLOCK readback exercises the staged BLOCK callback sink; modelspace readback exercises the ENTITIES delivery sink.

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; ASCII/Binary target and metadata refusal, destination preservation, corrected retry, and modelspace/named-BLOCK typed readback.
validation.fixturePolicy: No drawing fixture was added or committed.

limitations: This is generated DXF parser/serializer and adapter-delivery consistency evidence only; it is not independent physical producer or native-consumer evidence.

The official LIGHT page does not list the color group emitted by the existing writer. Color semantics beyond the bounded generated ACI transport profile, including truecolor/name/book mapping, remain unqualified.
DWG photometric, web-file, and extended-light payloads remain refused by the adapter writer until their output mapping is qualified.
No support claim is promoted; P8 remains open.
